results.title: India, Brazil reaffirm $30 billion trade target by 2030; Brazil to widen pharma market access
results.description: India and Brazil aim for $30 billion trade by 2030, with Brazil opening market access for Indian pharma. They discussed diversified trade, MERCOSUR, and cooperation in BRICS, G20.
